note: Nick's assigned priority countries as an analyst: Hungary and Slovakia (priority), Germany (secondary). Russia, Belarus and China are context countries (7.3): profiled for what they do to the eastern flank and to the three countries above, logged the same way, no baseline-requirement grid. The run appends dated facts to each country's log and keeps the profile current. Facts and summaries only; the item in the edition carries the So what. verified:false marks a fact to confirm against an official page.
blr: Continuity of government and critical services

countries.name: Hungary

gov.head: Péter Magyar
gov.title: Prime Minister
gov.majority: Tisza alone holds a two-thirds majority after the April 2026 election

nato.spend: 2.07% of GDP in 2025, down from 2.21% in 2024 (NATO estimates, March 2026)
posture: Croft training area used in the Spanish-led Strong Lineage 26 exercise, May to June 2026
Headquarters Multinational Division Centre at Székesfehérvár (to confirm current status)

stance.t: Magyar has said Hungary will deliver neither military vehicles nor lethal arms to Ukraine; first bilateral meeting with Zelensky in Brussels on 16 Oct 2026.
Foreign Minister Anita Orbán: Russia's current foreign policy is a risk; Hungary seeks a transparent bilateral relationship based on mutual interests.
The government is negotiating the release of about $20bn in frozen EU funds.

blr.t: Russian crude imports to end by October 2027, the government's stated deadline; gas still arrives via TurkStream through Serbia; the Economy and Energy Ministry ordered a financial review of the Paks II expansion in May 2026 and the government later proposed doubling its 2026 state financing.

log.t: The National Assembly elected Péter Magyar prime minister; Tisza holds a two-thirds majority on its own.
Magyar held his first bilateral meeting with President Zelensky in Brussels.
src: Just Security: Hungary's election is already paying dividends

log.t: In Vilnius Foreign Minister Anita Orbán said a 2030 EU accession date for Ukraine is not realistic and Hungary does not support a fast track, while backing Ukraine's bid.
src: LRT (BNS): Ukraine's EU accession by 2030 unrealistic, says Hungarian FM in Vilnius

log.t: NATO ordered Hungarian Gripens to escort three airliners threatened with hoax bombs on 6 Nov, one Brussels–Sofia and two out of Prague; no device was found.
src: Index: Bombafenyegetések miatt léptek készenlétbe a magyar Gripenek, a NATO is intézkedett
444: Néhány órán belül háromszor riasztotta a NATO a magyar Gripeneket utasszállító repülőket érintő bombafenyegetés miatt

log.t: Világgazdaság reported that Hungary withheld approval of the screening results for Ukraine's EU clusters 4 and 5 at the Council enlargement working group on 3 Nov, as on 20 and 27 Oct.
src: Világgazdaság: Orbán Anita nem a levegőbe beszélt: Ukrajna uniós csatlakozása

log.t: Prime Minister Magyar meets Chancellor Merz in Berlin on 10 Nov with the foreign, economy and energy, defence and interior ministers.
src: Index: Magyar Péter jövő héten Berlinben tárgyal Friedrich Merz német kancellárral
Ukrinform: Merz to discuss further support for Ukraine with Magyar

log.t: Foreign Minister Anita Orbán said on 7 Nov that Hungarian Gripens will fly Baltic Air Policing again in 2028, the fifth rotation.
src: Index: Orbán Anita bejelentette, 2028-ban ismét Magyarország védheti Európa keleti határait

log.t: Croatia's JANAF said the Adria crude pipeline, which also supplies MOL, was damaged during works on 6 Nov and the leak stopped.

countries.name: Slovakia

gov.head: Robert Fico
gov.title: Prime Minister
gov.majority: Smer-SD, Hlas-SD and the Slovak National Party hold 75 secure votes of 150 since MP Roman Malatinec left Strana vidieka on 3 Nov 2026; confidence vote won 18 Jun 2026

election.dateText: Parliamentary election due by late September 2027; Fico has floated a snap vote as early as January 2027
election.snapNote: Fico has floated a snap vote from January 2027

nato.spend: 2.0% of GDP in the 2026 budget, more than €2.88bn; government plan 3.5% by 2034
posture: Spain-led NATO Multinational Brigade at Lešť, Spain framework nation since July 2024 providing about 75% of the force; contributors include Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia and Turkey
Parliament approved up to 101 soldiers for NATO's Eastern Sentry

stance.t: Fico said on 21 Oct 2026 that neutrality would suit Slovakia better and spoke of the alliance's 'false solidarity', while saying Slovakia honours its commitments.
No military aid from state stocks; commercial exports by Slovak manufacturers continue.
Opposes further sanctions packages that touch Slovak energy; gas arrives via TurkStream through Hungary.

blr.t: Gas supply depends on TurkStream flows through Hungary since Ukrainian transit ended; Druzhba crude via Ukraine remains exposed to strikes and transit decisions.

log.t: The National Council expressed confidence in the Fico government.
In a televised debate Fico threatened snap elections if his coalition partners did not settle their dispute, suggesting January 2027.
src: Eurointegration: Why Slovakia could call snap elections

log.t: Fico said neutrality would suit Slovakia better than NATO's 'false solidarity'.
MP Roman Malatinec moved to Tomáš Taraba's party, leaving the coalition with 75 secure votes of 150; parliamentary votes were postponed to 10 Nov.
src: STVR: Koalícia prichádza o väčšinu: Roman Malatinec odchádza od Huliakovcov a pridáva sa k Tarabovej strane

log.t: At government consultations in Lviv Fico and Ukrainian PM Serhiy Koretskyi signed a joint declaration; Slovakia pledged €500,000 for 54 generators, €300,000 for shelters, €200,000 for hospital equipment and three locomotives.
src: Ukrinform: Koretskyi, Fico sign Ukraine-Slovakia cooperation agreement in Lviv
Interfax-Ukraine: Slovakia to provide Ukraine with generators and locomotives

log.t: The Commission's annual migration report, published 6 Nov, gave Slovakia no exemption from the 2027 solidarity pool; the Council decides by qualified majority.
src: TASR (teraz.sk): KDH: Vláda nedokázala vyrokovať výnimku z migračného paktu

log.t: Fico said on 6 Nov that the referendum of 2003 on joining the EU was falsified; he ruled out early elections before the 10 Nov votes.
src: Pravda.sk: Ficove slová o sfalšovanom referende vyvolali ostrú kritiku. Taraba varuje pred vážnymi dôsledkami
TN Live: Fico dal na svoje vyhlásenie uprostred schôdze prepraviť celý poslanecký klub

log.t: A “Mier pre Slovensko” rally in Košice on 7 Nov drew Smer and Republika MEPs criticising EU policy on Russia.
src: TASR via Naše Košice: Zhromaždenie Mier pre Slovensko. V Košiciach znela kritika vojenskej politiky EÚ

posture: Operationsplan Deutschland: the Bundeswehr's plan linking national and alliance defence with civil support, covering peacetime, hybrid threat, crisis and war
Host nation support: up to 800,000 allied troops and 200,000 vehicles must be able to move through Germany within six months (Bundeswehr)
Wehrdienst-Modernisierungsgesetz passed 5 Dec 2025: all 18-year-old men receive a questionnaire from January 2026; service stays voluntary with a compulsory fallback

stance.t: Largest European supplier of military aid; Merz hosts the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin on 19 Nov 2026.
Germany is NATO's logistics hub; Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) at Ulm; the Bundeswehr Joint Force Command runs host nation support as a whole-of-government task.

blr.t: Operationsplan Deutschland covers the military side only; civil defence sits with the Interior Ministry and the BBK; a reported €10bn civil-defence line by 2029 is not yet confirmed from an official source.
Host nation support planning assumes 800,000 troops and 200,000 vehicles in transit within six months; cost sharing between federal, state and municipal levels is still being examined.

log.t: The Bundestag passed the Wehrdienst-Modernisierungsgesetz in its final readings.
src: BMVg: Gesetzentwurf zur Modernisierung des Wehrdienstes

log.t: Defence Minister Pistorius named Lt Gen Christian Freuding the next Generalinspekteur from early February 2027, succeeding Gen Carsten Breuer, who becomes Chair of the NATO Military Committee in summer 2027.

hartpunkt: Generalleutnant Christian Freuding wird neuer Generalinspekteur der Bundeswehr

countries.name: Russia

gov.head: Vladimir Putin
gov.title: President
gov.party: United Russia holds the State Duma majority
gov.majority: Fifth term began 7 May 2024, to 2030. State Duma election held 18 to 20 Sep 2026 (result to confirm from the CEC)

election.dateText: Presidential election due March 2030; State Duma elected September 2026

nato.spend: SIPRI estimate 7.1% of GDP in 2024; federal budget 2025 allocated 13.5 trillion roubles to national defence, about 6.3% of GDP (to confirm against the 2026 budget law)
posture: Leningrad and Moscow military districts re-established 1 Mar 2024 facing Finland, the Baltics and Poland (to confirm current formations)
Baltic Fleet and the 11th Army Corps in Kaliningrad
Northern Fleet and the Bastion in the High North; see the Arctic theatre
Non-strategic nuclear weapons stationed in Belarus since 2023; Oreshnik deployment to Belarus announced (status to confirm)

spend.src: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, April 2025 release (to confirm)
spend.note: SIPRI estimate of military expenditure as a share of GDP; NATO publishes no figure for Russia.

stance.t: Full-scale war since 24 Feb 2022; US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 and 11 Nov 2026 with Medinsky leading the delegation (see the board).
New START expired 5 Feb 2026 with no successor treaty in force (to confirm any interim understanding).

Nuclear doctrine revised Nov 2024 to cover attacks by a non-nuclear state supported by a nuclear power; the Alliance named Russia the most significant and direct threat at the 2022 Madrid summit and has repeated it since.
Key rate, budget deficit and oil-and-gas revenue to be filled from the Bank of Russia and the Finance Ministry by the run; no figure is carried until sourced.

gov.head: Xi Jinping
gov.title: General Secretary and President
gov.majority: Third term as General Secretary since Oct 2022; 21st Party Congress due autumn 2027

election.dateText: No national election; the 21st Party Congress is due in autumn 2027

posture: Named by NATO a decisive enabler of Russia's war against Ukraine (Washington summit declaration, July 2024)
Joint naval and air patrols with Russia, including in the Arctic and the Baltic approaches; see the Arctic theatre
Taiwan Strait and ADIZ activity: see the Taiwan theatre and the ADIZ indicator

stance.t: Largest Chinese investment destination in Central Europe: BYD plant at Szeged and CATL at Debrecen under construction or starting (status to confirm); Budapest to Belgrade railway financed by China.
Strategic partnership signed during Fico's Beijing visit, 1 Nov 2024.
Germany's China strategy (July 2023) calls China partner, competitor and systemic rival; the Hamburg port terminal stake (COSCO 24.99%) stands.
Dual-use export controls on drone components and rare earths tightened in 2024 and 2025 (to confirm current list).
